transcript.text:
Thank you, Elena. I appreciate having this dedicated time to share my perspective. My complaint concerns Marcus repeatedly interrupting or redirecting me during our customer-transition project meetings. I've found this pattern disruptive to my ability to contribute effectively, and it has made it difficult for me to carry out my role as Project Analyst.

For the resolution, I'd like the plan to address two specific safeguards. First, I'm requesting that future project coordination for this work use a shared written channel — so that decisions, action items, and discussion points are documented in a place we both have access to and can reference. Second, I'm requesting that meeting agendas be sent at least 24 hours in advance of each of our recurring meetings. I believe these two measures would help create clearer structure, reduce the likelihood of interruptions and redirects, and allow both Marcus and me to come prepared and aligned on what needs to be discussed.

I want to be clear that these are concrete, reasonable steps that I believe will improve how we work together on this project going forward. I'm not asking for anything beyond what would help ensure more productive and respectful meetings. I hope the resolution plan can incorporate these safeguards along with any other measures that the rest of the team sees fit.
